summary: Stepan Company filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026 disclosing entry into a new $500 million Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent and Bank of America as syndication agent. The facilities comprise a $350 million multicurrency revolver and a $150 million delayed draw term loan, both maturing September 25, 2031, replacing prior $350 million and $100 million facilities from June 2022. Pricing ranges from 0.125%-0.625% over base rate or 1.125%-1.625% over SOFR/EURIBOR, leverage-based, plus a $250 million accordion. No special-situation event; watch covenant headroom.
